response.sql:
WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    analysis_count,
    1.0 * analysis_count / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS count_share
  FROM trader_type_counts
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(analysis_count) AS avg_count
  FROM trader_type_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.analysis_count) AS sum_counts,
  AVG(s.count_share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.analysis_count - ac.avg_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE s.analysis_count > ac.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: Trader types are the non-NULL tradekind values represented by qualifying analyses; counts are grouped before calculating the average and shares, and the final result is one aggregate row.
